text:
Priya (curation): quick sync — catalog launch sweep. we have three incoming open models: OpalLite-6B, ZephyrX-3B, Marigold13B. who owns final licensing signoff + perf profile for each? need blockers before EOD so product can freeze manifest.

Omar (ml): I can take OpalLite-6B perf profile. ran initial single-GPU perf yesterday, tail latency looks okay but needs quantization run to validate accuracy drop.

Li (runtime): i can run quant bench for OpalLite and Zephyr tomorrow morning. note: ZephyrX's activation pattern breaks our eager-kv cache assumptions, will need a small runtime tweak.

Jenna (legal): licensing quick note — OpalLite has an ambiguous contrib file. I flagged to upstream, waiting for reply. until we have explicit CLA/third-party notice, we should mark as "review pending" in catalog UI.

Marcus (infra): Marcus here — Marigold13B needs 40GB slice for our perf test infra. we only have one machine free in staging this week. can we move one slot from dedicated pool? cc @Carlos (product) for prioritization.

Carlos (product): prioritize Marigold if it's the only model blocking the landing page demo. otherwise OpalLite is higher usage. Marcus — give me the exact machine id and window, i'll reassign.

Omar (ml): quick code review ping: PR #4123 adds OpalLite tokenizer to model-registry. needs an owner approve for inference shim. @Priya (curation) can you delegate?

Priya (curation): assigning to @Omar (ml) for the shim review. i'll update the intake doc with owners: OpalLite -> Omar, Zephyr -> Li, Marigold -> Marcus infra + Carlos product for launch gating, legal -> Jenna oversight.

Li (runtime): runtime tweak for Zephyr is small — change in kv eviction policy. patch ready, will submit PR after I finish sanity runs. ETA 6h.

Jenna (legal): noted on OpalLite contrib. if no upstream reply by Thursday EOD, legal recommends we ship with a clear "license pending" flag and opt-out until cleared. more details in ticket LIC-339.

Marcus (infra): Marigold machine id: staging-gpu-12. can move slot from nightly CI between 01:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow. need confirmation by 21:00 UTC.

Carlos (product): confirmed — we'll take 01:00-06:00 UTC window. I'll update launch doc and notify marketing for demo schedule shift.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/zephyr-kv-fix -> staging at 4777771200. status: queued.

Li (runtime): saw the deploy-bot — i'll watch canary and post perf delta.

Omar (ml): on OpalLite quant — running `tools/quantize.py --model opallite --bits 4 --calib 2000` now, will push numbers in ~3h.

Priya (curation): action items summary: (1) Omar does OpalLite perf & PR review; (2) Li submits runtime PR and runs quant benches; (3) Jenna escalates or flags license; (4) Marcus moves staging-gpu-12 for Marigold in the overnight window; (5) Carlos updates launch schedule. i'll track in the intake doc and ping legal if no answer by Thu EOD.

Carlos (product): thanks — please ping me if any blocker pops.

Priya (curation): closing for now — will post a brief rollup in the catalog launch thread after these items finish. :thumbsup:
